# TaskFlow Frontend Code Of Conduct

## Our Commitment

The frontend repository is where product feel, usability, and client behavior meet.
Contributors are expected to keep collaboration respectful and quality-focused.

## Expected Behavior

- discuss UI and engineering tradeoffs respectfully
- raise usability, accessibility, and reliability concerns clearly
- keep feedback specific and helpful
- protect user trust in auth and client behavior

## Unacceptable Behavior

- hostile or dismissive review behavior
- mocking design or implementation work instead of reviewing it constructively
- exposing sensitive configuration in client-facing code

## Enforcement

Maintainers may reject, edit, or restrict contributions that hurt the team or frontend quality standards.
